name: NoPoSplat
definition: A method that eliminates the need for known camera poses by using a canonical coordinate system anchored to a single input view and introducing intrinsics token embeddings to resolve scale ambiguity.
summary: NoPoSplat is a 3D Gaussian Splatting method that eliminates the need for known camera poses by anchoring scenes to a canonical coordinate system, achieving superior novel view synthesis with minimal view overlap.
